question: Which Indian city recorded the highest PM2.5 level in 2023, making it the most polluted metropolitan area globally?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Begusarai**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Begusarai, Bihar was the most polluted city in India in 2023, **with an average PM2.5 concentration of 118.9 micrograms per cubic meter of air (μg/m³).
